package lesson

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// GetLesson fetches a single lesson by ID.
type GetLesson struct {
	Lessons repository.LessonRepository
}

// Handle returns lesson by ID.
func (uc GetLesson) Handle(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) (*domain.Lesson, error) {
	return uc.Lessons.Get(ctx, lessonID)
}

// HandleWithFields returns lesson with selected fields.
func (uc GetLesson) HandleWithFields(ctx context.Context, lessonID string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	return uc.Lessons.GetWithFields(ctx, lessonID, f)
}
